title: understudy.benchmark_review.v1
description: One human review decision against a machine-proposed benchmark task from the trace foundry. Stored as one JSON object per line in a reviews.jsonl file next to the foundry's manifest.json (understudy.trace_foundry.v1). The file is append-only: the newest line for a task_id supersedes older ones. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this review shape.

benchmark_id.description: Slug of the foundry output directory the reviewed task belongs to (the directory basename). Note: NOT an understudy.benchmark.v1 benchmark_id — proposed benchmarks have no promoted manifest yet.

task_id.description: task_id of the understudy.benchmark_task.v1 line in tasks.jsonl this decision judges.

decision.description: Human final judgment: accept (promote as-is), restrict (promote with a narrowed contract), needs_more (more evidence required), reject (never promote).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the decision was recorded.
